tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Filter expired leases using prev_end <= start before summing active seats.
tasks.mechanics: Expire completed leases at start before sequential capacity check; rejected leases never enter active state.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Clip endpoints to [low, high) instead of requiring full containment.
tasks.mechanics: Clip partially overlapping intervals rather than dropping them; ignore spans with right <= left.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Reset only the target channel mark instead of clearing all channels.
tasks.mechanics: Per-channel high-water state ignores stale/duplicate seq and resets locally per channel.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Keep batch_max intact on soft reset while still allowing negative batch peaks.
tasks.mechanics: Soft reset clears accumulator only; hard reset emits and clears both accumulator and historical batch peak.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Check full per-part multiplicity of a kit before mutating inventory.
tasks.mechanics: Sequential multiset demand with atomic rollback/precheck on partial shortage and empty-kit success.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Count distinct panel memberships per non-empty tag instead of raw tag occurrences.
tasks.mechanics: Deduplicate within each panel rather than globally or summing raw occurrences.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Move refreshed resident key to newest on 'put' and skip pinned keys when evicting.
tasks.mechanics: Refresh moves resident key to newest while preserving pin flag; eviction skips pinned keys without reordering survivors.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Consume group quotas in score-priority order before restoring original index order.
tasks.mechanics: Consume group quotas in priority order, then emit chosen positions in original index order without deduplicating names.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Expire vessels with prev_depart <= arrive before computing active tonnage.
tasks.mechanics: Release departed vessels before admission check; rejected vessels neither occupy berth nor affect peak tonnage.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Advance logical cursor only for 'data' segments while emitting one count per 'data' segment.
tasks.mechanics: Skip 'meta' segments without advancing logical payload cursor; preserve zero-overlap 'data' positions.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Clip bookings to [open_hr, close_hr) instead of skipping bookings that extend past window bounds.
tasks.mechanics: Clip bookings partially outside [open_hr, close_hr) and accumulate signed rates across duplicate or overlapping bookings.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Isolate per-escrow balances instead of sharing a global running balance across interleaved escrows.
tasks.mechanics: Interleaved escrow lifetimes maintain independent balances; voided escrows discard only their own balance and closed IDs reopen at zero.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Reset only the recalibrated sensor rather than clearing all sensor baselines.
tasks.mechanics: Per-sensor baseline starts on first sample of epoch (supporting negative values), ignores drops, and resets locally.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Preserve stage_min across 'pause' while resetting current level to 0.
tasks.mechanics: Inner pause resets current level only; outer close emits historical minimum (including positive-only minima) and clears stage state.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Aggregate per-sku basket demand and validate availability before mutating stock.
tasks.mechanics: Aggregate repeated sku lines within a basket before atomic check-and-deduct; rejected baskets leave stock unchanged.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Deduplicate repeated endorsements from the same ward before counting.
tasks.mechanics: Deduplicate (ward, candidate) pairs before counting wards per candidate; sort by (-count, candidate).

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Iterate or aggregate over full row multiplicities instead of deduplicating rows per key.
tasks.mechanics: Preserve repeated identical rows as distinct index positions while excluding same-team matches.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Promote an already-queued job to newest on 'push' before future drops or pops.
tasks.mechanics: Re-pushing queued job promotes it to newest without duplication or eviction; pop removes current oldest.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Record first appearance index only when valid_flag == 1.
tasks.mechanics: Ignore invalid logs for both point totals and tie-break appearance index; exclude actors with only invalid logs.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Evaluate budget deductions in priority order rather than input order, then emit accepted indices in input order.
tasks.mechanics: Allocate department budgets in priority order (skipping unaffordable high-priority items while still allowing cheaper lower-priority items), then restore input order.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Guard 'lock' and 'close' transitions on current state instead of unconditionally mutating state or counting redundant closes.
tasks.mechanics: State-guarded command dispatch ignores illegal transitions (such as locking while open or opening while locked) and counts only open->closed transitions.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Consume literal bytes in escape/pair modes before control dispatch and reject incomplete trailing modes.
tasks.mechanics: Multi-byte modal decoder consumes literal escaped/pair bytes without re-interpreting 254/255 inside payload positions and rejects truncated tails.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Add current delay before doubling, reset delay on 'ok', and break on 'fatal'.
tasks.mechanics: State-dependent backoff doubles after 'temp' up to max_delay, resets on 'ok', and halts immediately on 'fatal'.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Count elements with window frequency == 1 instead of len(set(window)) or cumulative frequency.
tasks.mechanics: Count multiplicity-1 elements inside each sliding window rather than distinct-set cardinality.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Track running window max and min rather than comparing only endpoints.
tasks.mechanics: Check full window max-min spread (not just adjacent differences or endpoint differences) bounded by max_len.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Initialize avg to samples[0] on index 0 and reset current streak on non-breach without losing max streak.
tasks.mechanics: Initialize EMA from first sample (not zero), update with floor division by 10, and track both longest breach streak and total breach count.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Check matching tag names on close, count transient depth on 'self', and require empty stack at end.
tasks.mechanics: Nested LIFO tag matching with depth ceiling applied to both open and self-closing tags, plus unclosed-stack rejection at EOF.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Leave non-matching opener on the stack when a mismatched closer arrives instead of popping it.
tasks.mechanics: Two-type LIFO bracket repair where mismatched closer neither pops nor closes an incompatible opener on the stack.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Credit elapsed time to current stack top before pushing callee or popping exiting function, rather than subtracting total span naively.
tasks.mechanics: Stack profiler accrues timestamp delta to current top-of-stack on both enter and exit transitions, supporting recursive self-calls.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Maintain a stack and drop zero-sum merged runs so newly adjacent matching labels coalesce.
tasks.mechanics: Stack-based run coalescing where cancellation to zero exposes earlier neighbor for cascading merges.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Ignore negative versions before recording first-seen package order, and update stored version with max.
tasks.mechanics: Negative versions neither appear in output nor establish first-seen package order; valid versions take max while keeping first-valid order.

tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Deduplicate values within each list before counting list memberships, and validate non-decreasing order on all lists.
tasks.mechanics: Validate non-decreasing input order on every list, count distinct list memberships per value, and emit qualifying values in ascending order.
